$comment: Machine-readable form of PROJECT_RULES.md Rule 3, the Score Isolation Principle. This file is the input to tools/uppercut_validate/score_isolation.py and satisfies the Phase 0 quality-gate item 'Scorecard access boundaries documented and testable'.

sealed_symbols.description: Names that constitute official-score access. Any reference from a forbidden consumer is a violation.

permitted_substitute.description: Rule 3: forbidden consumers may form imperfect estimates from observable events with explicit confidence and uncertainty.

additional_laws: Partial cards remain sealed during the immediate result, quick-menu and statistics flow; optional later archival reveal (Rule 3).
No rubber-banding, referee intervention, commentary certainty, CPU decision, advice, Crowd reward, or difficulty adjustment may use official scores (Rule 3).
Crowd systems may not read or alter official scores and may not provide a hidden generic multiplier (Rule 12).
